faqs.q: How long does a dental implant take?
faqs.a: Same-day implants are possible for some cases; full integration typically takes 3–6 months before the final crown is placed.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Fill in the booking form on this page and it will open WhatsApp with your details ready to send, or simply call us. We'll confirm your slot on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.a: Any previous dental X-rays or reports, a list of the medicines you take, and your insurance details if you plan to claim. Please arrive 10 minutes early.

faqs.q: How often should I have a dental check-up?
faqs.a: Every six months for most people. Regular check-ups and cleaning catch problems early, when treatment is simpler and less expensive.
Yes. Every instrument is cleaned and sterilised in a hospital-grade autoclave, and single-use items are never reused.

faqs.q: What should I do in a dental emergency?
faqs.a: Call us straight away. For a knocked-out tooth, hold it by the crown (not the root), keep it in milk and come in within an hour. For swelling, use a cold pack on the cheek — never a hot one.

faqs.q: I have diabetes / a heart condition / I'm pregnant. Can I still get treatment?
faqs.a: Usually yes. Please tell us about any health conditions and medicines (especially blood thinners) before treatment, so we can plan safely and coordinate with your doctor if needed.
